subtitle.en: From concept to reality, made simple.
subtitle.zh: 从概念到现实，简单实现。

description.en: We offer both standard and fully customized services, along with design recommendations and expert support, so you can easily visualize and refine your project's glass hardware before manufacturing begins — ensuring the final result is every bit as stunning as you imagined.
description.zh: 我们提供标准和完全定制的服务，以及设计建议和专业支持，让您在生产开始前轻松可视化和完善项目的玻璃五金——确保最终效果与您想象的一样惊艳。
